content.short: Radicle enables developers to securely collaborate on software over a peer-to-peer network.
content.description: Radicle gives developers a more secure and robust way to manage software by operating on a peer-to-peer network. It uses cryptographic verification to confirm additions, commits, pushes, and pulls for repositories, helping ensure integrity without relying on centralized services. Its workflow mirrors Git, so commands and concepts feel familiar to traditional developers, making collaboration on open-source projects safer and more self-reliant.
